hero_eyebrow: Pan African for Studies and Strategies Advisory
hero_lead: An independent think tank focused on analysis, innovation and applied knowledge for sustainable development across the African continent.
mission_quote: Rethinking, analysing and proposing new ways to address Africa's challenges, tailoring solutions to the specific realities of each country and context.
about_title:
A think tank
of a new kind
about_p1: PASS-A is a strategic thinking platform on Africa, capable of connecting academic knowledge, operational experience and forward vision to drive more effective and contextually adapted decisions.
about_p2: Structured as a non-profit association, it facilitates decision-making through strategic studies, experience sharing and the production of practical, actionable knowledge.
p1_text: To produce strategic knowledge applicable to the continent's real challenges.
p2_text: To become the reference platform for strategic thinking on Africa.
p3_text: Multisectoral, innovative and adapted to African realities.
p4_text: An international network of experts, institutions and economic actors.
a1_text: Production of multisectoral reports and analysis on economics, politics and development in Africa.
a2_text: Development of solutions adapted to the social, economic and regulatory realities of Africa.
a3_text: Promotion of best practices among experts, institutions and economic actors across the continent.
a4_text: Organisation of high-level events connecting ideas, needs and opportunities.
a5_text: Creating conversation spaces that bring together public, private and academic actors.
a6_text: Rigorous reports, analysis and content oriented towards decision-making and action.
collab_lead: We are building a reference community on Africa. You can join us in two different ways — choose the one that best fits your profile.
c1_text: If you have experience, research or perspectives on Africa, we want you on board. Intellectual collaborators form the active core of the think tank.
c1_features: Publication of articles and studies on our platform
Participation in forums, events and thematic debates
Access to the PASS-A network of experts and collaborators
Contribution from academic or professional backgrounds
c1_btn: I want to contribute my knowledge
c2_text: If you believe in PASS-A's mission and want to support its growth, your contribution helps us produce more studies, organise events and expand our community.
c2_features: Financial contribution to the think tank's development
Recognition as a collaborating or sponsoring entity
Access to exclusive reports, analysis and content
c2_btn: I want to support the project
footer_tagline: Independent think tank focused on strategic analysis and sustainable development in Africa.
